animations.name: medium kick v2
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One crisp medium kick from standing guard to full extension. Pivot onto the planted supporting foot, rotate the hips slightly away toward the rear, chamber the knee, and drive a high-mid back-angled side kick upward and to the right into the exact final pose with both fists tucked near the torso. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the supporting foot anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
